question: Is Reaper's Bell's existing non-final-enemy-death action-economy chain naturally owned, reproducibly available, inactive, viable and separately identifiable from Scoreline and Afterimage strongly enough to justify exact acquisition/proc/use telemetry before any causal ablation row?
competingOptions: authorise only observation-only acquisition, non-final-death proc and post-proc resource-use telemetry plus exact current-path identity proof
close the Reaper's Bell death-chain family and continue with another materially different mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

sourceFilter.selectionRule: Inspect exact current-main combat relic hooks after the cadence, Ward, Kindle and Shatter families are removed. Select the existing natural-pool relic whose positive action-economy payoff is gated specifically by an enemy death while another enemy remains alive. Freeze the sole result before reading ownership or outcome support.
sourceFilter.sourceHook: Inside _on_enemy_death, when another enemy remains alive and Reaper's Bell is owned, add exactly 1 Energy and draw exactly 1 card.

definition.name: Reaper's Bell
definition.text: When an enemy dies, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

candidate.mediator: A non-final enemy death while the relic is already owned produces one immediate Energy and one immediate draw, creating a bounded within-fight continuation opportunity.
candidate.authoredPayoff: Exactly +1 Energy and one draw at that trigger. No damage, Ward, Facet, Shatter, status, card definition, offer, rarity, policy score or RNG rule changes.
candidate.mechanisticJustification: The trigger is an enemy-death state transition rather than a play-count cadence, Shatter threshold, setup bit, repeated card instance or scalar acquisition preference. Duskblade's attack/Shatter targeting can exploit a continuation without making the relic aspect-gated.
candidate.claimBoundary: Final whole-run ownership plus any multi-enemy fight is deliberately only an upper-capacity condition. It cannot establish acquisition timing, a non-final kill while owned, a proc, use of the added Energy/draw, causal complementarity, package admission or product quality.

closedDirections: Executioner's Seal and every added Attack/card cadence relic
reward-Attack overchip, generic Shatter flow, Shatter count, Crown and reseam
Prism Charm and Bell of Endings evidence retained by immutable issue #524
one-bit and Power-cycle setup, heavy-Attack relay and Honing repeat
Ward, Kindle, Afterimage, Cracked and Resonant Lance
changing Reaper's Bell rarity, score, offer, trigger, resource values or forcing ownership

reapersBellDeathPayoff.current: Existing +1 Energy and one draw after a non-final enemy death while owned.
reapersBellDeathPayoff.status: Fixed observational mechanism; not varied and not a causal estimand.

scorelinePayoff.current: Exact frozen Scoreline payoff and Faultline path.

afterimagePayoff.current: Exact frozen Afterimage payoff and Guarded Strike path.
afterimagePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline and Reaper's Bell.

acquisitionPriority.current: Exact frozen policy and natural reward/economy path.

designMatrix.kind: single-cell immutable observational reuse; not a factorial
designMatrix.expansionRule: No joint cell is authorised. A complete pass may add identity-safe telemetry only. A causal factor, levels, equal-cohort CRN contrast and shared interference cells require a later preregistration before rows.

upperCapacityDefinitions.ownerRow: The final whole-run relic inventory contains Reaper's Bell. This can post-date earlier fights and therefore only overstates exposure.
upperCapacityDefinitions.chainCapableRow: At least one recorded fight begins with two or more enemies. No kill or proc is inferred.
upperCapacityDefinitions.potentialActiveRow: Both ownerRow and chainCapableRow are true.
upperCapacityDefinitions.robustOwnerPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are owner rows.
upperCapacityDefinitions.chainCapablePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are chain-capable.
upperCapacityDefinitions.potentialActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are potential-active.
upperCapacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of four frozen rows is potential-active.
upperCapacityDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Exactly one of four frozen rows is potential-active.
upperCapacityDefinitions.anyAcquiredPolicy: At least one frozen row ends with Reaper's Bell.
upperCapacityDefinitions.viablePotentialActivePolicy: The policy is potential-active and has at least one potential-active Vow-5 row whose whole-run outcome is win.
upperCapacityDefinitions.scorelineRoutePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.
upperCapacityDefinitions.afterimageRoutePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows record positive afterimageGuardDamage.
upperCapacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Potential-active for Reaper's Bell but not active for the named anchor.
upperCapacityDefinitions.anchorOnlyPolicy: Active for the named anchor but not potential-active for Reaper's Bell.

interactionAndAlias.mechanisticInteractions: None are estimated. Reaper's Bell, Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate fixed mechanisms.
interactionAndAlias.upperBoundAlias: Final ownership is aliased with unknown acquisition time, and a multi-enemy fight is aliased with unknown non-final kill/proc/use. Both aliases can only overstate activation, so failure is decisive and success authorises exact telemetry only.
interactionAndAlias.sharedInterferenceAnchors: Candidate-only, anchor-only and Jaccard gates are computed separately against the same exact Scoreline and Afterimage policy identities. No optional joint cell or Cartesian expansion exists.
interactionAndAlias.staging: Source and upper-capacity evidence may move to observation-only path/mediator telemetry. No whole-run causal endpoint is supported until every contrast shares the same frozen policies, seeds, baseline, estimator and stop rule.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: After trace and row-label fields are removed, every current row must exactly equal its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result before any candidate count is read.

scoreline.definition: Chisel precedes a later Faultline in the same fight in at least two of four rows.

afterimage.definition: Positive afterimageGuardDamage is recorded in at least two of four rows.

cohort.identity: The exact complete current-main first-look rectangle is reused for the candidate and both shared anchors. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

estimands.unit: Policy identity with the frozen two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.sourceUniqueness: Exact current-main relic hook, relic definition, natural uncommon-pool membership and poolWave2 gate.
estimands.primary: Exact robust-owner, chain-capable, potential-active, exact-inactive and ambiguous policy counts and identities under the deliberately permissive upper bound.
estimands.reachability: Exact policies with any final Bell acquisition and robust final ownership.
estimands.viability: Exact potential-active policies with at least one potential-active winning Vow-5 row.
estimands.separation: Separate exact candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard statistics against the frozen Scoreline and Afterimage policy identities.
estimands.notEstimated: No acquisition time, non-final kill, proc, Energy use, drawn-card use, causal payoff, interaction, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected-seed or product effect is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic current-main source assertions, exact multi-enemy fight capacity and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: One source-selected existing candidate, two immutable shared anchors, one immutable trace and one complete first look. No trigger, relic, predicate, threshold or cohort changes after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Authorise exact telemetry only if every gate passes; otherwise close the existing death-chain family or record inconclusive at the numeric cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive/ownership/capacity and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy first-look support scale. Both anchors use the same 0.75 Jaccard ceiling, and one fault is the immutable cached baseline.

decisionRules.success: Every source, owner-reachability, chain-capacity, potential-active, inactive, viability, separate Scoreline/Afterimage interference and reliability gate passes.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Add only observation-only Bell acquisition time, non-final-death proc identity, Energy/draw delta and post-proc resource-use telemetry. Prove omitted/current path, RNG, policy and result identity on the frozen cohort before any new simulator row. Do not add or vary a payoff, change trigger/resources/rarity/score/offers, force ownership or infer a causal endpoint.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the existing Reaper's Bell death-chain family and continue with the next materially different source- and evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not change the trigger, resource values, score, rarity, offer path or pair it with a hand-picked kill card.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The current-main source, immutable trace or deterministic screen cannot produce a complete decision before the numeric wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without telemetry, simulator spend, trace extension, a causal factor or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns source selection, source assertions, trace validation, upper-capacity classification, shared-anchor interference checks and stop/go. Existing exact traces are immutable input. No model context, human label, ML, RL, optimiser or adaptive candidate iteration enters the decision.
